text:
maya: Heads-up: reproducible duplicate-create when py client retries POST after backend 504; no Idempotency-Key so create happens twice.
owen: yikes. which client/version? sync or async?
maya: py-sdk 0.10.0, sync. We forced a short timeout to trigger it. logs: "POST /v1/notes -> 504, retrying -> 201 Created". No idempotency header.
rhea: we historically left idempotency to apps. Possible fixes: warn at runtime, reduce POST retry defaults, or add opt-in auto-idempotency middleware that generates UUIDs on retry.
owen: async client also has an issue: streaming/generator bodies can't be rewound, which blocks replay. We should align sync/async behavior.
maya: short-term: lower POST retry count and emit warning when POST+retries>0 and no Idempotency-Key. Long-term: middleware with buffer limit (e.g., 512KB) to auto-generate Idempotency-Key only when safe.
rhea: agree. also update docs and typing: call out AsyncClient limitations and show examples for setting Idempotency-Key per request.
devex-bot: Created ticket DE-5301: "py-sdk: duplicate-create on POST retry; idempotency middleware + async replay fix" assigned to rhea and owen.
